changeSet.comment: Grant semantic Order permission the legacy order-entry modules still enforced by ModuleAuthenticationInterceptor
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_role_module ( id, has_select, has_add, has_update, has_delete, system_role_id, system_module_id ) SELECT nextval('clinlims.system_role_module_seq'), src.has_select, src.has_add, src.has_update, src.has_delete, order_role.id, src.system_module_id FROM clinlims.system_role_module src JOIN clinlims.system_role reception_role ON reception_role.id = src.system_role_id AND reception_role.name = 'Reception' JOIN clinlims.system_role order_role ON order_role.name = 'Order' JOIN clinlims.system_module module_ref ON module_ref.id = src.system_module_id WHERE module_ref.name IN ( 'SamplePatientEntry', 'SampleEntryByProject', 'SampleEntryByProject:initial', 'SampleEntryByProject:verify', 'SampleEdit', 'SampleEdit:readwrite', 'SampleEdit:readonly', 'PrintBarcode', 'SampleBatchEntry', 'SampleBatchEntryOnDemand', 'SampleBatchEntryPrePrinted' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_role_module existing WHERE existing.system_role_id = order_role.id AND existing.system_module_id = src.system_module_id );
